targets.rawSQL: SELECT summary_hour AS time, CAST(close_price AS DOUBLE) AS close_price FROM market_hourly_summary WHERE summary_hour >= (SELECT MAX(summary_hour) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM market_hourly_summary) ORDER BY summary_hour

SELECT summary_hour AS time, CAST(kline_volume AS DOUBLE) AS kline_volume FROM market_hourly_summary WHERE summary_hour >= (SELECT MAX(summary_hour) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM market_hourly_summary) ORDER BY summary_hour
SELECT summary_hour AS time, trade_count FROM market_hourly_summary WHERE summary_hour >= (SELECT MAX(summary_hour) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM market_hourly_summary) ORDER BY summary_hour

SELECT summary_hour AS time, CAST(avg_trade_price AS DOUBLE) AS avg_trade_price FROM market_hourly_summary WHERE summary_hour >= (SELECT MAX(summary_hour) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM market_hourly_summary) ORDER BY summary_hour

SELECT summary_hour AS time, maker_trade_count, taker_trade_count FROM market_hourly_summary WHERE summary_hour >= (SELECT MAX(summary_hour) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM market_hourly_summary) ORDER BY summary_hour

SELECT summary_hour, symbol, open_price, high_price, low_price, close_price, kline_volume, kline_quote_volume, kline_number_of_trades, trade_count, trade_qty, trade_quote_qty, avg_trade_price, maker_trade_count, taker_trade_count, updated_at FROM market_hourly_summary WHERE summary_hour >= (SELECT MAX(summary_hour) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM market_hourly_summary) ORDER BY summary_hour DESC LIMIT 100
